geography: Worldwide (Lilly Form 10-Q sales-by-product Total column: U.S. plus outside U.S.)
moa: Atypical antipsychotic (olanzapine) combined with a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (fluoxetine)

approval_evidence.quote: 12/24/2003 ORIG-1 Approval Type 4 - New Combination PRIORITY

launch_evidence.quote: Symbyax was launched in the U.S. in January 2004.

series_start_reason: Series starts at the launch quarter (January 2004); the first-quarter 2004 Form 10-Q prints a Symbyax row with no prior-year figure.
series_end_reason: The Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2006 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000095013706005239/c04851e10vq.htm, row 'Symbyax 12.9 0.5 13.4 12.6 6 %') is the last Lilly filing with a Symbyax sales row. The Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2006 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000095013706008651/c07379e10vq.htm) contains no occurrence of 'Symbyax' at all, and no later Lilly 10-Q, 10-K or earnings-release exhibit filed through 2017 has a Symbyax table row (row scan of every Lilly 10-Q/10-K and item 2.02 exhibit); the releases mention Symbyax only inside a list of products 'launched this decade'.
search_log: Listed every Eli Lilly (CIK 59478) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages (all forms); fetched every 8-K/8-K/A whose items include 2.02, 12, 9 or 7.01 (or carry no items) filed 2003-10 to 2017-12 with all exhibits from each filing's index.json, and every 10-Q, 10-K and 10-K/A primary document in that range.

Scanned all of them for table rows whose first cell starts with 'Symbyax' (rows.py) and for any occurrence of the word (grep.py). Rows exist only in the Forms 10-Q for 2004Q1-2005Q3 and 2006Q1 and in the Form 10-K for 2005 (2005 and 2004 full years); the 2004 Form 10-K and the 2006Q2 and later 10-Qs have no Symbyax row.

Q4 2004 and Q4 2005 are derived as full year less the third-quarter 10-Q nine-month Total. Year checks: 2004 = 33.7 + 7.9 + 13.5 + 15.2 = 70.3 vs printed 70.2 only because Q4 is derived from 55.0, which is itself the printed nine-month total (33.7+7.9+13.5 = 55.1 against printed 55.0 - one-decimal rounding in the 10-Q); 2005 = 12.6 + 14.9 + 13.0 + 13.4 = 53.9 = printed full year.
Each row checked offline with verify_staged_manifests.check_row before writing.
